name: Maruhi Jinjibu Ryoujokuka
source:
Tetsuo works at an IT company, but he was shunted off due to sex scandals. One day, he is called to the president's room. The president says, "There are three female university students who applied for our company. We really want to employ them, so don't let them apply for other companies. You can do whatever you want to accomplish that." The president gives him a smile, and Tetsuo understands it. He starts to give the girls sex training from the next day....

translation:
Tetsuo在一家IT公司工作，却因性丑闻被调去闲职。一天，他被叫进社长办公室。社长说道：“有三名女大学生应聘我们公司。我们非常想录用她们，所以别让她们再去应聘别的公司。为了做到这一点，你可以不择手段。”社长朝他一笑，Tetsuo立刻心领神会。从第二天起，他开始对女孩们进行性调教…
